requiredSemantics: Use complete logical-end-bounded string validation for arbitrary and escaped keys and values.

Preserve normalization and text-normalization hints for every type/text pair, including escaped strings and duplicate keys.
Compact-only unsupported whitespace, scalars, nesting or invalid syntax must fall through with all parser state and hints unchanged.
Require depth<MAX_JSON_NESTING for the eliminated single object frame.
Literal data/style parent admission must preserve strict top-level glossary key/required-field state.
Consume only the child closing brace; publish OBJECT_AFTER_VALUE and leave the parent's delimiter handling unchanged.
Do not count prior generic key-validation/selector overhead as removed.
Measure failed probes and rescanned bytes across real JMdict/Jitendex/VNDB before timing; any-field admission removes third-field rejection but does not bound long failing probes.
